name: Pigeon Pose
steps: Start on all fours and slide one knee toward the wrist on that side.
Angle your front shin across your hips and slide the opposite leg straight back.
Support yourself on your hands and ease your hips toward the floor.
Relax into the stretch deep in the outer hip and glute of your front leg while breathing slowly and steadily.
Hold the stretch calmly on one side, then press back onto all fours and switch legs.
tips: Place a folded towel beneath the hip of your bent leg if it hovers high off the floor or feels strained.
Stop immediately if you feel any pinching or pressure in the front knee and bring your heel closer to your hip.
